headline: OpenAI's Luna rockets to #1; DeepSeek crosses 20% share
summary: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 vaulted three spots to claim the top position with 14.1% token share, while DeepSeek crossed into 20.2% provider share—its biggest single-day jump yet at +4.8%. Tencent dropped to #2 after leading yesterday, and the top two providers now command 37.6% of the market between them.
highlights: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 surges from rank 4 to #1 (+7.0% token share in one day)
DeepSeek provider share hits 20.2%, up 4.8% in 24 hours—largest daily gain in the dataset
OpenAI climbs to 17.3% provider share (+6.6% daily), reclaiming serious ground
Tencent's hy4-preview slides to rank 2 after dominating, down 6.0% token share
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 jumps 10 ranks in a week to rank 5, now at 6.7% share
Two new entrants: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash (rank 8) and Google's gemini-3.5-flash-lite (rank 51)
Two dropouts: OpenAI's gpt-oss-20b and Anthropic's claude-4.5-haiku exit the top 50
